company.name: Arpeggio Bio
company.shortDescription: Arpeggio builds technology to watch and learn how drugs work.
company.description:
Arpeggio Biosciences leverages state of the art sequencing approaches coupled with powerful machine learning to uncover novel insights into a compound's biological mechanism of action.

The company is diverse set of molecular biologists, computer scientists, and biotechnology enthusiasts passionate about understanding where, why, and how therapeutics work.

aiResearchSummary.text: Arpeggio Bio is engaged in developing methods for identifying markers for biological interactions, as described in 'Method for identifying a marker for a biological interaction.' This involves quantifying genome-wide RNA expression in cells and exposing them to a perturbagen to induce biological interactions, enabling the observation and analysis of drug effects at the molecular level. Their research and development focus on technologies that elucidate how drugs interact with biological systems.
